articles.title: RAG Makes Guardrails Brittle? Investigating Robustness of Guardrails under RAG-style Contexts
articles.abstract: With the increasing adoption of large language models (LLMs), ensuring the safety of LLM systems has become a pressing concern. External LLM-based guardrail models have emerged as a popular solution to screen unsafe inputs and outputs, but they are themselves fine-tuned or prompt-engineered LLMs vulnerable to data distribution shifts. In this paper, taking Retrieval Augmentation Generation (RAG) as a case study, we investigate how robust LLM-based guardrails are against additional information embedded in the context. Through a systematic evaluation of 3 Llama Guards and 2 GPT-oss models, we find that inserting benign retrieved documents flips the judgments of input and output guardrails in around 11% and 8% of cases respectively, with the majority of these flips (72% and 64%) reversing previously correct decisions. We further analyze the effect of each component in the augmented context: retrieved documents, user query, and LLM response. Two tested mitigations reveal that the robustness gap is not easily closed. These results expose a context-robustness gap in current guardrails.
articles.titleCn: RAG是否使护栏变得脆弱？调查RAG式上下文下护栏的鲁棒性
articles.abstractCn: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）的日益普及，确保LLM系统的安全性已成为紧迫的议题。外部基于LLM的防护模型作为筛选不安全输入和输出的流行解决方案已出现，但它们本身也是经过微调或提示工程、易受数据分布偏移影响的LLM。在本文中，以检索增强生成（RAG）为例，我们研究了基于LLM的防护模型在面对上下文中嵌入的额外信息时的鲁棒性。通过对3个Llama Guard和2个GPT-oss模型的系统性评估，我们发现插入无害检索到的文档分别在约11%和8%的情况下反转了输入和输出防护模型的判断，其中大部分反转（分别为72%和64%）是逆转了先前正确的决策。我们进一步分析了增强上下文中每个组件的影响：检索到的文档、用户查询和LLM响应。两种测试的缓解措施表明，鲁棒性差距难以轻易弥补。这些结果揭示了当前防护模型中存在上下文鲁棒性差距。

articles.title: DEBATE: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Evaluating Opinion Dynamics in Role-Playing LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Modeling opinion change through social interactions is important for understanding polarization, misinformation, and societal conflict. Recent work simulates opinion dynamics with role-playing LLM agents (RPLAs), but multi-agent simulations often display unnatural group behavior (e.g., premature convergence) and lack empirical benchmarks for assessing alignment with real human group interactions. We introduce DEBATE, a benchmark for evaluating the authenticity of opinion dynamics in multi-agent RPLA simulations. Its three-round design makes each participant's public interaction history complete and traceable. DEBATE contains multi-round public messages and private Likert-scale beliefs from U.S.-based participants across 107 topics. The dataset covers 2,788 participants in 697 groups, enabling evaluation at the utterance and group levels. We instantiate "digital twin" RPLAs with seven LLMs and evaluate across two settings: Next Message Prediction and Full Dynamics Simulation, using stance-based opinion-dynamics metrics. In zero-shot settings, RPLA groups exhibit strong opinion convergence relative to human groups. Across group-generalization tests with unseen participant groups and topic-generalization tests with unseen discussion topics, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) of Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Qwen3.5-4B, and Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 improves stance-based alignment and reduces excessive convergence, bringing RPLA group convergence closer to that observed in the corresponding human groups, though discrepancies in opinion change and belief updating remain. The dataset, benchmark website, and codebase are publicly available.

articles.titleCn: 辩论：一个大规模基准，用于评估角色扮演大型语言模型代理中的意见动态
articles.abstractCn: 通过社会互动模拟观点变化对于理解两极分化、虚假信息和社會衝突至關重要。近期研究通過角色扮演的大型語言模型代理（RPLAs）模擬觀點動態，但多代理模擬常顯示不自然的群體行為（例如，過早收斂）並缺乏用於評估與真實人類群體互動一致性的實證基準。我們介紹了DEBATE，一個用於評估多代理RPLA模擬中觀點動態真實性的基準。其三輪設計使每個參與者的公開互動歷史完整且可追溯。DEBATE包含來自美國參與者在107個話題上的多輪公開信息傳遞和私人利克特量表信念。數據集涵蓋了697個群體中的2,788名參與者，允許在句子級別和群體級別進行評估。我們使用七個LLM實例化了“數字雙胞胎”RPLAs，並在兩個設置下進行評估：下一条信息預測和完整動態模擬，使用基於立場的觀點動態指標。在零樣本設置中，RPLA群體相較於人類群體顯示出強烈的觀點收斂。在包含未見參與者群體的群體泛化測試和包含未見討論話題的話題泛化測試中，對Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Qwen3.5-4B和Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3進行監督微調（SFT）可提高基於立場的一致性並減少過度收斂，使RPLA群體收斂更接近相應人類群體的觀察結果，儘管觀點變化和信念更新的差異仍然存在。數據集、基準網站和代碼庫均向公眾開放。

articles.title: Verify Before You Generate: Sketch-Guided Efficient Motion-Planning for Video Generation
articles.abstract: Recent video generation approaches increasingly rely on planning intermediate control signals like object trajectories to improve temporal coherence and motion fidelity. However, these methods mostly employ single-shot plans that are typically limited to simple motion instructions, leading to suboptimal motion quality, or iterative refinement which requires multiple calls to the video generator and incurs high computational cost. To address this trade-off, we propose SketchVerify, a training-free framework whose key insight is to verify motion plans using lightweight video sketches before invoking the expensive video generator. This lightweight planning space enables efficient comparison of multiple candidate trajectories and bounded iterative refinement before a single final video-generation pass. Given a prompt and a reference image, SketchVerify samples multiple candidate trajectories and renders each as a lightweight video sketch by compositing the moving objects over a static background. A vision-language verifier then ranks these sketches according to instruction alignment and visual motion consistency, allowing unsuitable trajectories to be rejected before full video synthesis. The motion plan is iteratively refined until a satisfactory one is identified, then passed to a trajectory-conditioned generator for final synthesis. Experiments on WORLDMODELBENCH and PHYWORLDBENCH demonstrate consistent improvements in instruction following and temporally coherent, visually plausible motion. Using the same ATI-14B generator, SketchVerify improves the aggregate WorldModelBench score from 7.71 to 8.71. Compared with full-video iterative refinement, it achieves a 13.1x planning-stage speedup and a 3.6x end-to-end speedup.
articles.titleCn: 生成前请先验证：基于草图的高效运动规划用于视频生成
articles.abstractCn: 近期视频生成方法越来越多地依赖规划中间控制信号，如物体轨迹，以提高时间一致性和运动保真度。然而，这些方法大多采用单次规划，通常仅限于简单的运动指令，导致运动质量欠佳，或者采用迭代优化，需要多次调用视频生成器并产生高昂的计算成本。为了解决这种权衡，我们提出了SketchVerify，这是一个无需训练的框架，其核心思想是在调用昂贵的视频生成器之前，使用轻量级视频草图来验证运动规划。这种轻量级的规划空间能够高效地比较多个候选轨迹，并在单次最终视频生成之前进行有限的迭代优化。给定一个提示和一个参考图像，SketchVerify会采样多个候选轨迹，并将每个轨迹通过将运动物体叠加在静态背景上进行渲染，生成轻量级视频草图。然后，一个视觉-语言验证器会根据指令一致性和视觉运动一致性对草图进行排序，从而在完整视频合成之前排除不合适的轨迹。运动规划会进行迭代优化，直到找到一个令人满意的结果，然后将其传递给轨迹条件生成器进行最终合成。在WORLDMODELBENCH和PHYWORLDBENCH上的实验表明，在指令遵循和时空一致、视觉合理的运动方面均有显著提升。使用相同的ATI-14B生成器，SketchVerify将WorldModelBench总分从7.71提升至8.71。与完整视频迭代优化相比，它在规划阶段实现了13.1倍的加速，并在端到端流程中实现了3.6倍的加速。

articles.title: Self-Distilled Reasoner: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Knowledge distillation improves large language model (LLM) reasoning by compressing the knowledge of a teacher LLM to train smaller LLMs. On-policy distillation advances this approach by having the student sample its own trajectories while a teacher LLM provides dense token-level supervision, addressing the distribution mismatch between training and inference in off-policy distillation methods. However, on-policy distillation typically requires a separate, often larger, teacher LLM and does not explicitly leverage ground-truth solutions available in reasoning datasets. Inspired by the intuition that a sufficiently capable LLM can rationalize external privileged reasoning traces and teach its weaker self, we introduce On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), a learning algorithm where a single LLM acts as both teacher and student with different contexts. The teacher policy conditions on privileged information (e.g., verified reasoning traces) while the student policy sees only the question; training minimizes the per-token divergence between these distributions over the student's own rollouts. We demonstrate the efficacy of our method on multiple mathematical reasoning benchmarks, achieving superior token efficiency compared to reinforcement learning methods and better performance over off-policy distillation methods. Code repo: https://github.com/siyan-zhao/OPSD.
articles.titleCn: 自蒸馏推理器：大语言模型的自策略蒸馏
articles.abstractCn: 知识蒸馏通过将教师大型语言模型（LLM）的知识压缩来训练更小的LLM，从而提升LLM的推理能力。策略内蒸馏通过让学生模型采样自己的轨迹，同时教师LLM提供密集的token级监督，推进了这一方法，解决了离线策略蒸馏方法中训练与推理之间的分布不匹配问题。然而，策略内蒸馏通常需要一个独立的、通常更大的教师LLM，并且没有明确利用推理数据集中可用的真实解。受“一个足够强大的LLM可以合理化外部特权推理轨迹并教导其较弱的自我”这一直觉启发，我们引入了策略内自蒸馏（OPSD），这是一种学习算法，其中单个LLM以不同的上下文充当教师和学生的角色。教师策略基于特权信息（例如，经过验证的推理轨迹），而学生策略仅看到问题；训练过程最小化学生自身轨迹上这些分布之间的每个token的偏差。我们在多个数学推理基准上展示了该方法的有效性，与强化学习方法相比，实现了更高的token效率，并且比离线策略蒸馏方法表现更好。代码库：https://github.com/siyan-zhao/OPSD。

articles.title: A Survey on Long-Term Memory Security in LLM Agents: Attacks, Defenses, and Governance Across the Memory Lifecycle
articles.abstract: The emergence of writable, cross-session persistent memory in LLM agents introduces a qualitatively different threat landscape from conventional input-centric security concerns, characterized by three properties: persistence, statefulness, and propagation. To systematically characterize this landscape, we propose a Memory Lifecycle Framework that organizes attacks, defenses, and their cross-phase dependencies along two axes: six lifecycle phases (Write, Store, Retrieve, Execute, Share & Propagate, Forget & Rollback) and four security objectives (Integrity, Confidentiality, Availability, Governance). This analysis in turn exposes the need for explicit security requirements at the system level, motivating Verifiable Memory Governance (VMG), a framework of five architectural primitives for specifying and evaluating auditable, recoverable control over memory state within declared system and threat-model boundaries. Our analysis motivates integrating provenance, versioning, and policy-aware retention with retrieval and execution defenses to support auditable prevention, containment, and recovery across the lifecycle.
articles.comment: 22 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Expanded version of the EMNLP 2026 paper. Adds evidence on persistent representations, skill memory, authorization changes, and recovery. Table 4 compares lifecycle security claims and their evaluation conditions
articles.titleCn: 对LLM代理长期记忆安全的研究：记忆生命周期中的攻击、防御与治理
articles.abstractCn: LLM智能体中可写入、跨会话持久化内存的出现，带来了与传统以输入为中心的安全关注点截然不同的威胁态势，其特征表现为三个属性：持久性、状态性和传播性。为系统性地刻画这一态势，我们提出了一个内存生命周期框架，该框架沿两个维度组织攻击、防御及其跨阶段依赖关系：六个生命周期阶段（写入、存储、检索、执行、共享与传播、遗忘与回滚）和四个安全目标（完整性、机密性、可用性、治理）。这一分析同时揭示了系统层面明确安全需求的需要，从而推动了可验证内存治理（VMG）框架的提出，该框架包含五个架构原语，用于在声明的系统边界和威胁模型范围内指定和评估可审计、可恢复的内存状态控制。我们的分析表明，需要将溯源、版本控制和策略感知保留与检索和执行防御相结合，以支持整个生命周期中的可审计预防、遏制和恢复。

articles.title: Compute Optimal Tokenization
articles.abstract: Scaling laws enable the optimal selection of data amount and language model size, yet the impact of the data unit, the token, on this relationship remains underexplored. In this work, we systematically investigate how the information granularity of tokens, controlled by the compression rate (i.e., average bytes of text per token), affects scaling trends. We train 988 latent tokenized models (BLT) ranging from 50M to 7B parameters that enable setting the desired compression rate. This flexibility allows us to study the role of compression rate well beyond 4.57 bytes per token obtained with a popular BPE tokenizer. Our experiments reveal that in compute-optimal configurations, model parameter counts scale proportionally to data size measured in bytes, not in tokens as commonly perceived (Kaplan et al., 2020; Hoffmann et al., 2022). Furthermore, we discover that the optimal compression rate differs from the one obtained with BPE and decreases with compute. These findings generalize to both latent and subword tokenization, as well as to languages other than English, guiding language model developers on tokenization scheme selection for maximal compute efficiency.
articles.titleCn: 计算最优分词
articles.abstractCn: 规模法则能够实现数据量与语言模型规模的优化选择，但数据单元——即标记——对这一关系的影响尚未得到充分探索。在本工作中，我们系统地研究了标记信息粒度（由压缩率控制，即每个标记的平均文本字节数）如何影响规模趋势。我们训练了988个潜在标记化模型（BLT），参数范围从50M到7B，这些模型能够设定所需的压缩率。这种灵活性使我们能够研究压缩率的作用，其范围远超常用BPE分词器获得的4.57字节/标记。我们的实验表明，在计算最优配置下，模型参数数量与以字节为单位的数据大小成正比，而非像通常认知的那样与标记数成正比（Kaplan等人，2020；Hoffmann等人，2022）。此外，我们发现最优压缩率与BPE获得的压缩率不同，并且随着计算量的增加而降低。这些发现适用于潜在标记化和子词标记化，也适用于英语以外的语言，为语言模型开发者选择最大化计算效率的标记方案提供了指导。

articles.title: Probing the Prompt KV Cache: Where It Becomes Dispensable
articles.abstract: Prior KV cache compression schemes empirically demonstrate that the prompt cache can be dropped or summarised during decoding with little accuracy loss, indicating that it is partly redundant. We ask when and what kind of redundancy, i.e., at which layers, after how many decoding steps, and in what form can the prompt span KV cache be replaced without breaking the task. A controlled splice intervention swept over layers and decoding steps shows this redundancy is about form rather than content. Replacing the upper layer prompt span KV cache with KV cache from a chat template scaffold with empty user content or filler tokens recovers near clean accuracy, while zeroing the entire prompt KV collapses accuracy. The dissociation replicates across the Qwen3, Gemma 3, and Llama 3 model families of varying sizes on multiple datasets. A serving implementation of this technique reduces KV memory by $15.4\%$, supports $18\%$ more HBM-constrained concurrent requests, and improves throughput by $13$-$21\%$.

articles.titleCn: 探测提示KV缓存：何时变得不再必要
articles.abstractCn: 现有的 KV 缓存压缩方案通过经验证明，在解码过程中可以丢弃或总结提示缓存，而损失很少的准确性，这表明其存在部分冗余。我们探究何时以及何种形式的冗余，即在哪一层、经过多少步解码、以何种形式，可以替换提示 KV 缓存而不破坏任务。一项受控的拼接干预在层和解码步骤上进行了扫描，表明这种冗余主要在于形式而非内容。用带有空用户内容或填充标记的聊天模板骨架中的 KV 缓存替换上层提示 KV 缓存，可以恢复接近纯净的准确性，而将整个提示 KV 缓存置零则会降低准确性。这种解耦在多个数据集上对 Qwen3、Gemma 3 和 Llama 3 等不同规模的模型家族都得到了验证。这项技术的服务实现减少了 15.4% 的 KV 内存占用，支持了 18% 更多受 HBM 限制的并发请求，并提升了 13% 至 21% 的吞吐量。

articles.title: Towards Understanding On-Policy Distillation through the Lens of Test-Time Scaling
articles.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as a promising post-training technique for enhancing LLM reasoning. Under the reverse KL objective, the idealized optimum of OPD aligns the student distribution with that of the teacher. When the teacher consistently outperforms the student, this naturally suggests that OPD should yield broad improvements over the pre-OPD student. However, do such improvements extend across the entire range of test-time sampling budgets? In this work, we revisit this expectation through the lens of test-time scaling by varying the sampling budget $K$ and evaluating performance with pass@$K$. Across multiple settings, we observe two distinct patterns: OPD can improve pass@$K$ at both small and large sampling budgets, but it can also improve small-budget performance while reducing large-budget pass@$K$. We show one condition that guarantees such a reversal and an idealized reverse KL counterexample where it occurs even when the teacher has higher accuracy on every problem. To choose between two candidate teachers at a target sampling budget, we propose the \textit{Teacher Advantage Score at $K$} (TAS@$K$), which can be computed before OPD training to predict which teacher will lead to a larger improvement in pass@$K$. Across three domains and thirteen benchmarks, the ordering predicted by TAS@$K$ agrees with the observed pass@$K$ improvements of the resulting OPD models in 83.6\% of experiments, providing a useful signal for teacher selection at the target pass@$K$.

articles.titleCn: 通过测试时缩放视角理解在线策略蒸馏
articles.abstractCn: 离线策略蒸馏（OPD）已成为提升大型语言模型推理能力的有前景的微调技术。在反向KL目标下，OPD的理想化最优解将学生分布与教师分布对齐。当教师始终优于学生时，这自然表明OPD应使预OPD学生获得广泛提升。然而，这种提升是否适用于整个测试时采样预算范围？在本工作中，我们通过测试时缩放视角重新审视这一预期，通过改变采样预算$K$并使用pass@$K$评估性能。在多种设置下，我们观察到两种不同模式：OPD既能提升小预算和大预算的pass@$K$，也能在小预算提升的同时降低大预算的pass@$K$。我们展示了一个保证这种逆转的条件，以及一个理想化的反向KL反例，即使教师在每个问题上的准确率更高，该逆转也会发生。为了在目标采样预算下选择两个候选教师之一，我们提出了$K$预算下的教师优势分数（TAS@$K$），该分数可以在OPD训练前计算，以预测哪个教师将导致更大的pass@$K$提升。在三个领域和十三个基准测试中，TAS@$K$预测的排序与OPD模型在测试时观察到的pass@$K$提升在83.6%的实验中一致，为在目标pass@$K$下的教师选择提供了有用信号。

articles.title: AhaBench: Do Agents Turn Experience into Reusable Insights? A Long-Horizon Benchmark for Continual Learning
articles.abstract: Solving a task, even from a worked example, does not make an agent any better at the next one. As agents move from single tasks to long collaborations with people, turning experience into reusable insight becomes the capability that separates a tool from a collaborator that improves over time. AhaBench is a benchmark for this kind of continual learning. It simulates three patterns of long human-AI collaboration and holds a later test fixed while varying the experience before it: in Aha-Puzzle, the agent questions a partner who knows the answer to a new mystery after solving earlier ones; in Aha-Euler, a person teaches a computation and the agent applies it to new inputs; in Aha-Vending, the agent runs a delegated business for a simulated year. The learning mechanism is left open, so memories, skill libraries, and weight updates can be compared under common rules against a baseline of fixed-weight agents that see their experience in context. Our results show that today's frontier agents are not yet continual learners. Earlier Aha-Puzzle solutions help some models, most clearly Qwen 3.6 Plus, which gains +12.57 points over attempts on the same stories without earlier episodes, yet every model scores far below what it reaches with hints. On single-step Aha-Euler tasks, the same model solves 94.0% of requested held-out inputs when taught with an explanation and code but 6.0% when given only the question and answer, counting unanswered attempts as incorrect. In incident-free Aha-Vending operation, Doubao Seed 2.0 Pro ends the year at +495 USD, yet its profit averaged over the year is -10 USD because it recovers late. Exploring without help, reconstructing a method, and sustaining productive operation remain open problems, and AhaBench provides the paired tests a learning method must pass to solve them.
articles.titleCn: AhaBench：智能体如何将经验转化为可复用见解？一个用于持续学习的长时程基准
articles.abstractCn: 解决一个任务，即使是通过参考示例，也不会让智能体在下一个任务中变得更好。随着智能体从单一任务转向与人类的长期协作，将经验转化为可重用的洞察力，成为了区分工具和随时间改进的协作者的关键能力。AhaBench是一个用于这种持续学习的基准测试。它模拟了三种长期人机协作的模式，并在其中一种测试保持固定，而改变之前的经验：在Aha-Puzzle中，智能体在解决早期谜题后，向知道新谜题答案的伙伴提问；在Aha-Euler中，一个人教授计算方法，智能体将其应用于新的输入；在Aha-Vending中，智能体为模拟的一年时间运营一个委托业务。学习机制保持开放，因此记忆、技能库和权重更新可以在相同规则下与固定权重的基线智能体（这些智能体在其经验背景下看到结果）进行比较。我们的结果表明，当今前沿的智能体还不是持续学习者。早期的Aha-Puzzle解决方案对某些模型有所帮助，最明显的是Qwen 3.6 Plus，它在没有早期情节的情况下尝试相同故事时得分提高了+12.57分，但每个模型的得分都远低于使用提示时达到的水平。在单步Aha-Euler任务中，当通过解释和代码进行教学时，同一模型解决了94.0%的请求保留输入，但当仅提供问题和答案时，解决了6.0%，未回答的尝试被视为错误。在无事件的Aha-Vending运营中， Doubao Seed 2.0 Pro在年底结束时盈利+495美元，但其年平均利润为-10美元，因为它在后期才恢复盈利。在没有帮助的情况下探索、重建方法以及维持高效运营仍然是开放的问题，而AhaBench提供了学习方法必须通过的配对测试，以解决这些问题。

articles.title: MatLoom: Layered Text-to-Material Generation in a Compact Program Space
articles.abstract: Material generation should produce not only an appearance, but also the rules that construct it. We introduce MatLoom, a compact, layer-oriented language for text-to-material generation with pretrained language models. Each program composes alpha-masked layers whose shared spatial expressions define coverage and physically based rendering (PBR) channels, making dependencies between patterns, color, and relief explicit. A standalone interpreter evaluates the program into material maps, while the source retains named fields and layer parameters for subsequent authoring. Without task-specific fine-tuning, our pipeline uses parser-guided repair and preview-based critique to revise material designs, then searches noise seeds while keeping each candidate's remaining source fixed. On a curated benchmark of 141 prompts evaluated with six backbones, our best-performing configuration achieves higher mean scores than three diffusion baselines on all four flat-layout prompt-alignment metrics, and the margin persists on seven of the eight metric-layout cells under feasible equal-budget selection including best-of-10 sampling with the same quick scorer, with staged CLIPScore a statistical tie. A per-metric oracle bound over the same ten samples, which requires test labels, narrows the judge margins to 6.1 points flat and a staged statistical tie. Its initial programs already exceed all three baselines on mean BLIPScore, before critique or seed search. Retained programs have a median length of 21 lines when pooled across backbones. In a blind four-way comparison involving 30 participants and 20 prompts, our renders receive 59.2% of choices, compared with 19.3% for the most-preferred baseline. Compact executable programs thus offer a way to generate prompt-aligned materials while retaining their construction as part of the asset.
articles.titleCn: MatLoom：紧凑程序空间中的分层文本到材料生成
articles.abstractCn: 材料生成不仅应产生外观，还应生成构建它的规则。我们介绍了MatLoom，一种紧凑、面向层的文本到材料生成语言，配备了预训练语言模型。每个程序都组合了alpha掩码层，其共享的空间表达式定义了覆盖范围和基于物理的渲染（PBR）通道，使图案、颜色和浮雕之间的依赖关系明确化。一个独立的解释器将程序评估为材料图，而源代码保留命名字段和层参数以供后续创作使用。无需针对特定任务进行微调，我们的流程使用解析器引导的修复和基于预览的评论来修订材料设计，然后在保持每个候选源代码固定的情况下搜索噪声种子。在一个包含141个提示、使用六个主干网络评估的精选基准测试中，我们表现最佳的配置在所有四个平面布局提示对齐指标上均实现了高于三个扩散基线的平均分数，且在可行的等预算选择中，包括使用相同快速评分器的最佳10次采样，这一优势在八种指标布局单元中的七种上仍然存在，而分阶段CLIPScore实现了统计上的平局。在相同十个样本上，一个针对每个指标的预言机界限，需要测试标签，将裁判差距缩小到平面6.1分，并实现了分阶段统计平局。其初始程序在所有主干网络合并时，在平均BLIPScore上已经超越了所有三个基线，甚至在评论或种子搜索之前。保留的程序在所有主干网络合并时，中位长度为21行。在一个涉及30名参与者和20个提示的盲法四向比较中，我们的渲染获得了59.2%的选择，而最受欢迎的基线仅为19.3%。因此，紧凑的可执行程序提供了一种在保留其构建过程作为资产一部分的同时生成提示对齐材料的方法。

articles.title: Frozen Scenes, Shifting Winners: Configuration Fragility in Text-to-3D Evaluation
articles.abstract: Can a text-to-3D leaderboard change when every generated scene stays fixed? We audit this question for rendered-image evaluation, where camera settings and caption wording become part of the measurement protocol. Across 300 frozen scenes from six generators, we vary eight render and caption factors for 19 alignment evaluators plus one perceptual-quality control, then test four targeted scene degradations. Peak configuration variance exceeds between-generator variance for 19/19 alignment evaluators, with prompt-bootstrap lower bounds above 1 for 19/19. Rankings are more stable than scores, yet 18/19 evaluators change their point-estimate winner under some configuration. Pairwise protocol margin envelopes show which comparisons keep their direction across the tested settings. Selected pairs have opposite pointwise intervals, but no reversal survives simultaneous inference over the full search. Thus the observed winner changes are descriptive, not confirmed changes in generator superiority. Sensitivity remains separate: no evaluator exceeds 71% tie-adjusted directional discrimination on layout scrambling, and a preregistered blinded human study classifies part of the configuration variance as metric artifact. The audit separates score stability, decision uncertainty, and targeted sensitivity, and recommends reporting (generator, score, card ID) with protocol-dependent comparisons and selection-aware uncertainty.
articles.titleCn: 冻结场景，易变赢家：文本到3D评估中的配置脆弱性
articles.abstractCn: 当每个生成的场景都保持固定时，文本到3D排行榜会变化吗？我们针对渲染图像评估对此问题进行审计，其中相机设置和标题措辞成为测量协议的一部分。在来自六个生成器的300个冻结场景中，我们针对19个对齐评估器加上一个感知质量控制器，变化了八个渲染和标题因素，然后测试了四种目标场景退化。对于19/19个对齐评估器，峰值配置方差超过了生成器间方差，其中19/19的提示引导下限超过1。排名比分数更稳定，但19/19个评估器在某些配置下改变了其点估计赢家。成对协议边框显示了哪些比较在测试设置中保持了其方向。选定的成对比较具有相反的点估计区间，但在全面搜索的同时推断中没有任何逆转得以幸存。因此，观察到的赢家变化是描述性的，而不是生成器优越性的确认变化。敏感性仍然独立：没有评估器在布局打乱时超过71%的调整后方向性辨别率，并且一项预先注册的盲法人类研究将部分配置方差分类为指标伪影。审计区分了分数稳定性、决策不确定性和目标敏感性，并建议报告（生成器、分数、卡片ID），结合协议相关的比较和选择感知的不确定性。

articles.title: CHSM8: A Chess Transformer that Follows Natural-Language Style Prompts
articles.abstract: We present CHSM8, a 210M-parameter chess transformer that plays moves conditioned on a free-text description of a playing style, e.g. "go for the Sicilian Defense", "solid, safe, risk-free chess" or "You are Magnus Carlsen in his prime". The model is pretrained without search on 1.07B filtered Lichess games, using a factorized move representation and legal-move masking. It reaches 1837 Elo against a strength-limited Stockfish and, in 1,000-game matches, beat every other public model we tested that was likewise trained without preference tuning, rewards or search, including one with 13 times as many parameters. We then fine-tune it to follow text on a synthetic dataset: Gemma-4-31B describes the playing style of 3M game sides, a 1B Gemma-3 model distilled from the 2.4M of those descriptions that contradict nothing on the board labels the rest, and every one of 30M selected game sides gets five descriptions. Supervised fine-tuning attaches a frozen text encoder through gated cross-attention, and direct preference optimization (DPO) uses the same moves under a mismatched description as the rejected sample. After DPO, style adherence rises on every prompt we test (for example, queens traded early 53% -> 67%, pawn moves 29% -> 32% of all moves, queenside castling 97.3% -> 99.7%), and strength without a prompt stays within noise of SFT (1792 vs. 1797 Elo). Design choices at every stage were made by fixed-budget automated search loops on top of standard architectures and training recipes. We document the full pipeline and the decisions behind it, report the ablations that failed, and evaluate the models across many style prompts and kinds of games, with 1,000 games per setting. The work is fully open source and reproducible: weights, datasets with all training labels, prompts, configurations, inference code and playable demos are public and free to build on.
articles.titleCn: CHSM8：一个遵循自然语言风格提示的国际象棋Transformer模型
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了CHSM8，一个210M参数的棋类Transformer模型，该模型根据自由文本描述的棋风进行走棋，例如“寻求西西里防御”、“稳健、安全、无风险的棋风”或“你是处于巅峰时期的马格努斯·卡尔森”。该模型在1.07B个经过筛选的Lichess对局数据上进行无搜索的预训练，采用因子化走棋表示和合法走棋掩码。它在与限制强度的Stockfish对战中达到了1837 Elo，在1000局对局中击败了我们测试的所有其他公共模型，这些模型同样未经偏好调整、奖励或搜索训练，其中一些模型的参数量是它的13倍。随后，我们使用合成数据集对其进行微调以遵循文本：Gemma-4-31B描述了300万局对局的棋风，1B的Gemma-3模型从其中240万条不与棋盘标签矛盾的描述中蒸馏而来，其余部分由该模型描述，并且每一条300万条选定的对局都有五个描述。监督微调通过门控交叉注意力连接了一个冻结的文本编码器，而直接偏好优化（DPO）则使用与不匹配描述相同的走棋作为被拒绝样本。在DPO之后，我们在所有测试提示上（例如，早期换后：53% -> 67%，兵走棋：所有走棋的29% -> 32%，王翼易位：97.3% -> 99.7%）都提高了风格遵循度，而无需提示的实力保持在SFT噪声范围内（1792 vs. 1797 Elo）。每个阶段的架构选择都是通过在标准架构和训练配方之上的固定预算自动搜索循环做出的。我们记录了完整的工作流程及其背后的决策，报告了失败的消融实验，并在许多风格提示和不同类型的对局中评估模型，每个设置进行1000局对局。这项工作是完全开源且可复现的：权重、包含所有训练标签的数据集、提示、配置、推理代码和可玩演示都是公开的，并且可以免费基于它们进行构建。

articles.title: Beyond Aggregate WER: In-domain Adaptation, Learner Speech, Code-Switching, and Speaker Attribution in Online Spanish Learning Classrooms
articles.abstract: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) increasingly supplies transcripts for educational NLP, but aggregate word error rate (WER) can conceal errors concentrated in learner speech, multilingual turns, and speaker attribution. We compare platform-integrated, open-weight, adapted, and commercial ASR configurations on held-out sessions of online L2 Spanish interaction between L1 English learners and their instructors and tutors. Because English is the learner's shared first language, the interactions contain Spanish-only, English-only, and code-switched turns. Evaluation combines overall WER and character error rate (CER), WER disaggregated by speaker role and language context, and diarization error rate (DER). We also adapt Whisper large-v3 and MOSS-Transcribe-Diarize with LoRA using human-corrected in-domain classroom data. MOSS adaptation produced consistent improvements across speaker roles and language contexts, whereas Whisper showed smaller gains. Domain match proved more important than data volume: Larger out-of-domain bilingual and learner corpora did not outperform the smaller classroom corpus, where learner speech and code-switching are embedded in instructor--learner interaction. The open-weight MOSS adapter was competitive with commercial Muse Voice Transcribe on WER and CER and achieved lower system-provided DER on the recordings eligible for each system. Learner, English-only, and code-switched speech remained more difficult than instructor and Spanish-only speech. The findings demonstrate the value of condition-aware evaluation and interactionally matched data for bilingual educational ASR.
articles.titleCn: 超越整体WER：领域内适应、学习者语音、代码转换和说话人归属在线西班牙语学习课堂
articles.abstractCn: 自动语音识别（ASR）越来越多地为教育自然语言处理提供文本转录，但总体词错误率（WER）可能掩盖学习者语音、多语轮次和说话人归属中的集中错误。我们在L1英语学习者和他们的教师及助教之间在线进行的L2西班牙语互动的保留会话中，比较了平台集成、开放权重、适配和商业ASR配置。由于英语是学习者的共同第一语言，互动中包含仅西班牙语、仅英语和代码转换的轮次。评估结合了总体WER和字符错误率（CER）、按说话人角色和语言环境细分的WER，以及说话人分割错误率（DER）。我们还使用人类校正的领域内课堂数据，通过LoRA技术对Whisper large-v3和MOSS-Transcribe-Diarize进行适配。MOSS适配在所有说话人角色和语言环境中都产生了持续改进，而Whisper的增益较小。领域匹配的重要性超过数据量：更大的域外双语和学习者语料库并未优于较小的课堂语料库，其中学习者语音和代码转换嵌入在教师-学习者互动中。开放权重的MOSS适配器在WER和CER上与商业Muse Voice Transcribe具有竞争力，并在每个系统适合的录音上实现了更低的系统提供的DER。学习者、仅英语和代码转换的语音仍然比教师和仅西班牙语语音更具挑战性。这些发现证明了条件感知评估和交互匹配数据对于双语教育ASR的价值。

articles.title: TS-GEAR: Taobao Shangou GEnerative Ad Retrieval
articles.abstract: On-demand delivery platforms such as DoorDash and Uber Eats impose a constraint absent in traditional e-commerce: merchants beyond the user's delivery range are invalid candidates rather than merely low-ranked. Generative retrieval has recently shown strong potential in large-scale retrieval systems. Adapting it to this setting, however, poses three challenges. First, existing semantic IDs encode geography only as a soft signal, so reachability can only rely on a non-differentiable post-generation hard truncation. Second, user preferences vary substantially across both regions and queries, so aggregating historical behaviors without conditioning on geography and the current query yields biased interest estimates. Third, the retrieved candidate set is evaluated by its collective value, yet autoregressive training scores each sequence independently, with no set-level signal to discourage redundant near-duplicates. To address the challenges, we propose TS-GEAR, a unified generative retrieval framework for on-demand delivery: (1) Geo-Semantic ID splits merchant identifiers into geographic prefixes and semantic suffixes, making reachability a prediction target rather than a post-hoc filter; (2) Query-Geo Target Attention aggregates historical behaviors using the real-time query and location as dual targets, while encoding each behavior's own location into its attention key; (3) GMPO (Group Marginal Policy Optimization) rewrites advantages using a deduplicated group reward and marginal advantage within GRPO, avoiding auxiliary diversity objectives. Deployed online with a lightweight 0.1B backbone, TS-GEAR serves over 150 million queries per day in the search advertising pipeline of Taobao Shangou, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art generative retrieval methods on both HitRate and geographic validity, and achieving 3.8% gains in ad impressions and 4.2% in ad revenue.
articles.titleCn: TS-GEAR：淘宝商钩生成式广告检索
articles.abstractCn: 像DoorDash和Uber Eats这样的即时配送平台在传统电子商务中不存在一个约束条件：超出用户配送范围的商家被视为无效候选，而不仅仅是排名靠后。生成式检索最近在大规模检索系统中展现出巨大潜力。然而，将其应用于此场景提出了三个挑战。首先，现有的语义ID仅将地理位置编码为软信号，因此可达性只能依赖非可微分的生成后硬截断。其次，用户偏好在不同地区和查询之间存在显著差异，因此在不考虑地理位置和当前查询的情况下聚合历史行为会导致有偏的兴趣估计。第三，检索到的候选集通过其整体价值进行评估，但自回归训练独立评分每个序列，没有集合级别的信号来抑制冗余的近似重复项。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了TS-GEAR，一个用于即时配送的统一生成式检索框架：(1) 地理语义ID将商家标识符拆分为地理前缀和语义后缀，使可达性成为预测目标而非事后过滤器；(2) 查询地理目标注意力使用实时查询和位置作为双重目标聚合历史行为，同时将每个行为自身的地理位置编码为其注意力键；(3) GMPO（组边缘策略优化）使用去重组奖励和GRPO内的边缘优势重写优势，避免辅助多样性目标。在轻量级的0.1B主干网络上部署在线，TS-GEAR在淘宝商家的搜索广告流程中每天处理超过1.5亿次查询，在HitRate和地理有效性方面持续优于最先进的生成式检索方法，并在广告展示量和广告收入上分别实现了3.8%和4.2%的增长。

articles.title: MarineSparkLM-4B: A Lightweight Language Model for Marine and Offshore Engineering Built by Parameter-Efficient Adaptation
articles.abstract: Marine and offshore engineering knowledge is scattered across preprints, open-access journals, encyclopedias and institutional documents, but remains small by pretraining standards. We examine how far parameter-efficient adaptation can take a lightweight domain model on a workstation-class device. Starting from OceanGPT-basic-4B-Instruct, we trained two LoRA adapters, each updating 33.0 million of 4.06 billion parameters (0.81%). Training on one NVIDIA DGX Spark took 4 hours 40 minutes for the first adapter and 10 minutes for the second. The first used next-token prediction on a 61.6-million-token corpus covering ten engineering themes. Of 13,879 source documents, 7,069 remained after deduplication and a two-tier keyword filter to remove cross-domain lexical collisions. Validation loss fell from 2.082 to 1.976 over 1,500 steps. After the continuation adapter drifted off topic on a retrieval-grounded ballast-water prompt, we trained an instruction adapter on 2,295 question-answer pairs: 114 hand-written and 2,181 generated by the base model from corpus passages. Loss was applied only to answer tokens. On 20 held-out prompts, hand-scored for accuracy, topicality and specificity (maximum 120), the base model, continuation adapter, instruction adapter and instruction adapter with retrieval scored 42, 56, 84 and 81. The retrieval score reflects a corrected index-leakage issue. A paired test supports the instruction-tuning gain but finds no retrieval benefit on this set. Accuracy remained low: 14/40 without retrieval and 16/40 with it. A second evaluation used prompts from passages excluded from both instruction-data splits, addressing selection leakage in round one. It confirmed the instruction-tuning gain (p=0.0001 and p=0.0002) and found that retrieval significantly helped the base model, but not the instruction adapter.
articles.titleCn: 海洋火花LM-4B：一种用于海洋与近海工程的轻量级语言模型，通过参数高效微调构建而成
articles.abstractCn: 海洋与海上工程知识分散在预印本、开放获取期刊、百科全书和机构文件中，但按预训练标准来看仍然规模较小。我们研究了参数高效的适配技术能在工作站级设备上推动轻量级领域模型达到何种程度。从OceanGPT-basic-4B-Instruct开始，我们训练了两个LoRA适配器，每个适配器更新4.06亿参数中的3300万参数（0.81%）。在单个NVIDIA DGX Spark上训练，第一个适配器耗时4小时40分钟，第二个适配器耗时10分钟。第一个适配器基于一个涵盖十个工程主题的6160万标记语料库进行下一标记预测。在13,879份源文档中，经过去重和两层关键词过滤以消除跨领域词汇冲突后，剩余7,069份。验证损失在1500步内从2.082降至1.976。当延续适配器在基于检索的压载水提示上偏离主题时，我们基于2,295个问答对训练了一个指令适配器：其中114个手工编写，2,181个由基础模型从语料库段落生成。损失仅应用于答案标记。在20个保留提示上，针对准确性、主题性和特定性（最高120分）进行人工评分，基础模型、延续适配器、指令适配器和带检索的指令适配器得分分别为42、56、84和81。检索得分反映了修正后的索引泄漏问题。配对测试支持指令微调的增益，但发现该数据集上无检索优势。准确性仍然较低：无检索时为14/40，有检索时为16/40。第二次评估使用在两次指令数据分割中均被排除的段落提示，以解决第一轮中的选择泄漏问题。它证实了指令微调的增益（p=0.0001和p=0.0002），并发现检索显著帮助了基础模型，但对指令适配器无帮助。

articles.title: Safe Personal RSI: Evaluating and Repairing Personal-Agent Updates
articles.abstract: Kicker is a personal health assistant. Changes to an assistant's reusable instructions can improve task handling while changing what it discloses, which requests it follows, and how it reports actions. We study Safe Personal RSI, an update-evaluation component developed for Kicker. We restrict recursive self-improvement (RSI) to prompt updates, with model weights and runtime code fixed. The procedure tests proposed and current instructions, repeats failing cases, temporarily undoes changes to guide repairs, and checks safety and task performance before adoption. If no version passes, the current instructions stay in use. Our executable benchmark contains 29 email, calendar, health, and marketplace cases, with separate probes for authorization reuse, memory, and tool-output injection. Across three models and two deliberately risky edits, the procedure rejects 20 of 21 update attempts. In repair confirmation, an admitted GPT-5.6 Luna repair reduces attack violations from 10.7% to 0% and increases safe task completion from 89.7% to 100%; a broad handwritten authority rule matches these outcomes. Under stronger attacks, a repair transferred from Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct to Qwen3-14B reduces violations from 69.0% to 17.9% and increases safe task completion from 19.5% to 64.4%. Separate runtime probes examine memory-entry deletion and identify missing local OAuth scope checks in the evaluated snapshot.

articles.titleCn: 安全个人代理更新：评估和修复个人代理更新
articles.abstractCn: Kicker是一款个人健康助手。对助手可重用指令的修改可以改善任务处理能力，同时改变其披露内容、请求遵循的指令以及报告行动的方式。我们研究了Safe Personal RSI，这是为Kicker开发的一个更新评估组件。我们将递归自我改进（RSI）限制为提示更新，同时固定模型权重和运行时代码。该流程测试提议和当前指令，重复失败的案例，暂时撤销更改以指导修复，并在采用前检查安全性和任务性能。如果没有版本通过，当前指令将保持使用。我们的可执行基准包含29个电子邮件、日历、健康和市场的案例，分别针对授权重用、内存和工具输出注入进行探测。在三个模型和两个故意风险较高的修改中，该流程拒绝了21次更新尝试中的20次。在修复确认中，一个承认的GPT-5.6 Luna修复将攻击违规率从10.7%降至0%，并将安全任务完成率从89.7%提高到100%；一个广泛的亲笔授权规则与这些结果相匹配。在更强的攻击下，从Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct转移到Qwen3-14B的修复将违规率从69.0%降至17.9%，并将安全任务完成率从19.5%提高到64.4%。单独的运行时探测检查了内存条目删除，并识别出在评估快照中缺失的本地OAuth范围检查。

articles.title: What Does the Visual Encoder Buy? Visual Information Gain in Encoder-Free Multimodal Pretraining
articles.abstract: Recent scaling studies ask whether vision-language models still need a visual encoder by comparing encoder-free and encoder-based models on the next-token loss of the text in image-text data. This loss can fall without any use of the image, and two runs with the same loss can differ in what they take from it. Visual information gain (VIG) is the loss increase when the image is replaced by a uniform one. It splits exactly into global information, carried by image statistics, and layout information, which shuffling the patches within the image destroys. We apply it to decoders with 158M to 1.04B parameters that read pixel patches through a linear embedding, evaluated every billion tokens up to 40B, and to 19 public checkpoints. In our decoders the image lowers the loss by 3% to 46%, depending on the image type. Global information is present after the first billion tokens. Layout information starts near zero, grows slowly with training and does not grow with model size on five of six image types, and a larger batch reaches the same loss with less of it. With a frozen SigLIP 2 encoder in front of the same decoder the loss is lower only when the arrangement of the image is intact. On shuffled images the losses with and without the encoder agree to within 0.04 nats on five of six image types, so the net advantage of the encoder in the loss is layout information, above all the ability to read text in images. Public encoder-free models at production scale (Gemma 4 12B, NEO, Mono-InternVL) do acquire layout information. On the same documents they have 0.53 to 0.76 nats of it, against 0.65 to 0.82 for recent encoder-based models and 0.04 to 0.07 for our decoders, and their released training stages show it rising. These results agree with the reported parity of the two families when both are trained from scratch and place the reported advantage of a pretrained encoder in layout information.
articles.titleCn: 视觉编码器能买到什么？无编码器多模态预训练中的视觉信息增益
articles.abstractCn: 近期规模研究通过比较无编码器模型和基于编码器的模型在图像-文本数据中文本的下一词损失，探究视觉语言模型是否仍需视觉编码器。这种损失可以在不使用图像的情况下降低，并且两次具有相同损失的运行在从图像中获取的信息上可能不同。视觉信息增益（VIG）是当图像被替换为均匀图像时损失的增加量。它精确地分为全局信息（由图像统计数据携带）和布局信息（打乱图像内块会破坏的信息）。我们将其应用于参数量为1.58亿至10.4亿的解码器，这些解码器通过线性嵌入读取像素块，每处理十亿个词就评估一次，直到40亿个词，以及19个公开检查点。在我们的解码器中，图像使损失降低3%至46%，具体取决于图像类型。全局信息在处理十亿个词后出现。布局信息接近零开始，随训练缓慢增长，并且在六种图像类型中的五种上不随模型规模增长，较大的批次用更少的布局信息就能达到相同的损失。在相同解码器前放置一个冻结的SigLIP 2编码器时，只有当图像的排列完整时损失才会降低。在打乱图像上，六种图像类型中的五种上，有无编码器的损失差异在0.04纳特以内，因此编码器的净优势在于损失中的布局信息，尤其是读取图像中文字的能力。生产规模的公开无编码器模型（Gemma 4 12B、NEO、Mono-InternVL）确实获取了布局信息。在相同文档上，它们具有0.53至0.76纳特的布局信息，而近期基于编码器的模型为0.65至0.82纳特，我们的解码器为0.04至0.07纳特，并且它们发布的训练阶段显示该信息正在增长。这些结果与两种模型家族在从头开始训练时具有相同性能的报道一致，并证实了预训练编码器在布局信息方面的优势。

articles.title: ERA: Embed, Route, Adapt for Cold-Start Cross-Model Latent Retrieval
articles.abstract: Production retrieval systems are tied to the embedding model that indexed their corpus. Moving queries to a different encoder normally requires re-embedding the whole corpus, and at cold start there are no query logs while every document embedded by the new encoder incurs an API or compute cost. We present ERA (Embed, Route, Adapt), a system for cold-start cross-model latent retrieval. ERA spends a small anchor budget on maximally informative documents, selected from the existing target index via Cosine Farthest Point Sampling, trains a lightweight adapter with a Manifold Alignment Loss that couples directional alignment with orthogonal regularization to prevent representation collapse, and pairs the adapter with a deterministic router that escalates the rare, hard queries that define perceived retrieval quality. Across five BEIR datasets, ERA matches or outperforms point-wise L2 and embedding-conversion baselines, with relative gains of up to 35% nDCG@10 on Arguana, and on clustered corpora its anchor selection also improves prior methods under a fixed anchor budget. With 1.2 ms of adapter and router overhead on top of a ~20 ms local encoder, ERA at a 20% nominal escalation budget reduces end-to-end query latency from roughly 160 ms to 38-86 ms while concentrating escalations on the queries where the projection fails most.
articles.titleCn: ERA：嵌入、路由、适应，用于冷启动跨模型潜在检索
articles.abstractCn: 生产检索系统与索引其语料库的嵌入模型紧密相连。将查询迁移到不同的编码器通常需要重新嵌入整个语料库，而在冷启动阶段，由于新编码器嵌入的每个文档都会产生API或计算成本，因此没有查询日志。我们提出了ERA（嵌入、路由、适配）系统，用于冷启动跨模型的潜在检索。ERA在信息量最大的文档上花费少量锚预算，通过余弦最远点采样从现有目标索引中选择这些文档，使用流形对齐损失训练一个轻量级适配器，该损失将方向对齐与正交正则化相结合以防止表示崩溃，并将适配器与一个确定性路由器配对，该路由器会升级定义感知检索质量的罕见、困难查询。在五个BEIR数据集上，ERA与点式L2和嵌入转换基线相比，性能相当或更优，在Arguana上相对增益高达35%的nDCG@10，并且在聚类语料库上，其锚选择在固定锚预算下也改进了现有方法。在本地编码器约20 ms的基础上，适配器和路由器增加了1.2 ms的开销，ERA在20%的名义升级预算下将端到端查询延迟从约160 ms降低到38-86 ms，同时将升级集中在投影失败的查询上。

articles.title: Partially canonical axes in large language model representations
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) develop rich internal representations of language, but whether their individual coordinate axes carry meaning, or whether meaning is encoded only in directions in representation space, is still an open question. A common assumption is that individual axes in LLMs are arbitrary. We here challenge this view: across 12 LLMs from six model families, the native axes are reliably more aligned with other models' representations, with human brain responses to language, and with interpretable linguistic features than randomly rotated axes that preserve the same geometry. The native axes nonetheless fall well short of the best achievable alignment, so LLM coordinates are not fully arbitrary but also not fully canonical: they are partially canonical. A theory of how LLMs represent language must explain both the population geometry they learn and why individual units acquire patterns of response profiles that recur across systems.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型表示中的部分规范轴
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）发展出丰富的语言内部表征，但它们各自的坐标轴是否具有意义，或者意义是否仅编码在表征空间的方向中，仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。一个普遍的假设是LLMs中的单个轴是任意的。我们在此挑战这一观点：在六个模型家族的12个LLMs中，原生轴比随机旋转且保持相同几何形状的轴更可靠地与其他模型的表征、人类大脑对语言的反应以及可解释的语言特征对齐。尽管如此，原生轴仍远未达到最佳可达到的对齐程度，因此LLM坐标并非完全任意，但也并非完全规范：它们是部分规范的。一个关于LLMs如何表征语言的理论必须解释它们学习的群体几何形状，以及为什么单个单元会获得在系统中反复出现的反应模式。

articles.title: Self-similar Organization of Information in Language
articles.abstract: How much information relevant to predicting the future of a passage (i.e. predictive information) is carried by the preceding text, and how is this information distributed along that history? These questions are fundamental to understanding both the statistical structure of language and what large language models (LLMs) can learn about it. Indeed, LLMs trained to predict the next token in text must exploit this predictive information, so its organization determines how the structure of language becomes available to the model to learn. We develop a theory for the organization of predictive information based on the scaling behavior of a family of information measures, and the theory predicts that if this organization has the same form at all measured length scales -- i.e., it has a self-similar structure -- then the information measures evaluated at different lengths collapse onto a common form. We observe this scaling collapse in long text documents, showing that predictive information is present at every length scale we measure and has a self-similar structure. Self-similarity is a considerably stronger property than showing the existence of long-range dependencies, and it constrains the process generating the text. More broadly, our results give quantitative support to the empirical observation that conditioning on more distant text continues to reveal new structure in language to LLMs.
articles.titleCn: 语言中信息的自相似组织
articles.abstractCn: 前文包含了多少与预测段落未来（即预测信息）相关的信息，以及这些信息如何沿着历史分布？这些问题对于理解语言的统计结构和大型语言模型（LLM）能从中学习的内容至关重要。事实上，训练用于预测文本下一个标记的LLM必须利用这种预测信息，因此其组织方式决定了语言结构如何向模型呈现以供学习。我们基于一族信息测量的缩放行为，建立了一种关于预测信息组织方式的理论，该理论预测，如果这种组织在所有测量的长度尺度上都具有相同的形式——即具有自相似结构——那么在不同长度上评估的信息测量将汇聚成一种共同的形式。我们在长文本文档中观察到这种缩放汇聚现象，表明预测信息存在于我们测量的每个长度尺度上，并具有自相似结构。自相似性是一种比证明长程依赖存在更强的属性，它约束了生成文本的过程。更广泛地说，我们的结果为经验观察提供了定量支持，即基于更遥远的文本继续揭示语言对LLM的新结构。

articles.title: Beyond Prompt Heuristics: Assessing Child Safety Alignment in LLMs
articles.abstract: Child-safety taxonomies typically characterize safety risks through a predefined set of harm categories, and existing evaluations largely operationalize these categories using prompts that explicitly invoke them. However, child-safety considerations can also arise in seemingly benign requests that lack recognizable harm-category cues. We therefore investigate how child-safety alignment generalizes to such settings. Across six models, we find considerably higher misalignment rates on requests without recognizable harm-category cues than on those containing such cues (80.0, 54.0, and 48.4 percentage-point gaps for Qwen3.5-27B, GPT-5.4-mini, and Claude-Haiku-4.5, respectively). Through controlled behavioral and mechanistic analyses, we find that introducing a single harm-associated word reduces misalignment across most models, with mechanistic evidence suggesting that child-safety reasoning may rely in part on lexical and semantic associations with words in the prompt. Our findings motivate evaluations that treat child safety as context-dependent, and not reducible to a fixed set of harm categories.

articles.titleCn: 超越提示启发式：评估大型语言模型中的儿童安全对齐
articles.abstractCn: 儿童安全分类通常通过预定义的损害类别来表征安全风险，现有的评估主要使用明确调用这些类别的提示来操作化这些类别。然而，儿童安全考虑也可能出现在看似无害且缺乏可识别损害类别线索的请求中。因此，我们研究了儿童安全一致性如何推广到此类场景。在六个模型中，我们发现对于缺乏可识别损害类别线索的请求，其错配率显著高于包含此类线索的请求（Qwen3.5-27B、GPT-5.4-mini和Claude-Haiku-4.5分别存在80.0、54.0和48.4个百分点的差距）。通过受控的行为和机制分析，我们发现引入单个与损害相关的词语可以减少大多数模型的错配率，机制证据表明儿童安全推理可能部分依赖于提示中词语的词汇和语义关联。我们的研究推动了对儿童安全进行情境化评估，而非将其简化为固定的损害类别集。

articles.title: Right Numbers, Wrong Story: When LLMs Narrate Financial Changes Beyond Their Inputs
articles.abstract: A financial report drafted by an LLM can state every number correctly but still go beyond its input, adding judgments and causes that no one supplied. We call these additions unsupported framing and find them far more often in LLM drafts than in reports written by proInput facts Revenue +3% Higher prices 10-K filings Revenue increased 3% on higher prices. 10-K writer Revenue surged 3% on higher prices, due to strong demand. LLM Fits the size? Surged: Unusual for 3% In the input? In the input? Strong demand: Not in input Higher prices: Kept fessionals, and attempts to fix them by prompting with how each word is used instead make such judgments more frequent. We therefore propose FrameCheck, a plug-in that sits beFrameCheck Revenue increased 3% on higher prices. No extra model call Judgment word Unsupported cause Supported cause tween the LLM and human review to keep each draft within its input. Specifically, FrameCheck 1) guides the draft with professional examples that report a change of similar magnitude, 2) flags judgments that professionals would not use and causes the input does not give, and 3) removes them by rule, without a model call. In experiments on 17 open LLMs and 3M drafts, FrameCheck removes almost all unsupported framing from drafts and brings the judgment rate close to that of the writers of 10-K filings, the annual reports that US firms file with regulators. Code is available at github.com/seunghan96/framecheck.
articles.titleCn: 数字正确，故事错误：当大型语言模型叙述超出其输入范围的经济变化时
articles.abstractCn:
一个由大型语言模型（LLM）起草的财务报告可以正确陈述每一个数字，但仍然超出其输入范围，添加了无人提供的判断和原因。我们将这些添加称为“不受支持的框架”，并在LLM起草的报告中发现它们远比专业人士撰写的报告中更常见。以下是具体的例子：

**输入事实**：收入增长3%，由于价格上涨。
**10-K报告**：收入因价格上涨增长了3%。
**LLM报告**：收入因价格上涨激增3%，由于需求强劲。

**FrameCheck分析**：
- **激增**：3%的增长不寻常，输入中未提及。
- **强劲需求**：输入中未提及。
- **价格上涨**：保留。

**专业人士报告**：收入因价格上涨增长了3%。

**FrameCheck插件**：
FrameCheck是一个插件，位于LLM和人工审查之间，以确保每个草稿都在其输入范围内。具体来说，FrameCheck 1) 通过报告类似规模变化的专家示例来指导草稿，2) 标记专业人士不会使用的判断和输入未提供的因果关系，3) 通过规则移除它们，无需模型调用。

在17个开源LLM和300万份草稿的实验中，FrameCheck几乎从草稿中移除了所有不受支持的框架，并将判断率接近于美国公司向监管机构提交的年度报告（10-K报告）的撰写者水平。代码可在github.com/seunghan96/framecheck获取。

articles.title: Run One, Get Two: Near-Free Streaming Safety Checks for Local LLMs
articles.abstract: Local LLM assistants decode for one user at a time, so decoding is bound by memory bandwidth and leaves compute idle. Streaming safety checks today trade accuracy against cost. A dedicated guard model is accurate but nearly doubles the latency per token, while a hidden-state probe is cheap but less accurate. We present ToRA, an adapter that runs a second model as an extra row in the generator's decode step, sharing its weights and KV cache. Dual-row kernels read each weight once for both rows. On Qwen3-0.6B, ToRA matches or beats a dedicated streaming guard, with higher F1 on 12 of 17 benchmarks. It detects 11.8 points more unsafe responses than the probe at a similar cost, under 4% added latency per token.
articles.titleCn: 运行一次，获得两次：本地大型语言模型的免费安全检查
articles.abstractCn: 本地LLM助手一次为一位用户解码，因此解码受内存带宽限制，导致计算资源闲置。当前的流式安全检查在准确性和成本之间进行权衡。专门的防护模型虽然准确，但几乎将每个token的延迟翻倍，而隐藏状态探测方法成本较低但准确性较低。我们提出了ToRA，这是一种适配器，它作为生成器解码步骤中的一行额外模型运行，并共享其权重和KV缓存。双行内核为两行分别读取每个权重一次。在Qwen3-0.6B上，ToRA与专门的流式防护模型相当或更优，在17个基准测试中的12个上F1分数更高。在相似成本下，它比探测方法多检测出11.8个不安全响应，每个token的延迟增加不到4%。

articles.title: From Letter-of-Credit Requirements to Executable Specifications: Evaluating Verification Accuracy and Completeness
articles.abstract: In letter-of-credit (LC) document examination, a correct final decision does not show that every requirement was examined. We therefore evaluate examination requirement by requirement and make each requirement executable. A language model converts the bill of lading (BL) and commercial invoice (IV) requirements of a credit into atomic conditions and logical structures, and a deterministic verifier retrieves the named evidence and computes each outcome, so every check can be compared with a gold encoding and traced to logged evidence. Because LC records are confidential, our on-premises 9B parser is fine-tuned only on synthetic pairs built from templates and human-reviewed public document values. On 345 real LC cases, final-decision accuracy proves misleading: a constant PASS rule has the highest raw accuracy while examining nothing. Although it never sees a real record during training, the fine-tuned parser detects 93% of the atomic requirements its ontology covers and reconstructs 86% of the covered requirements exactly. It verifies 82% of the evaluable requirements correctly, against 54% for a tool-using agent, and leads the agent on both satisfied requirements and discrepancies. It also completely examines 1.8 times as many cases as few-shot prompting of the same model, while direct prediction and the agent complete none. Executing the gold encodings with the same verifier shows that some of the remaining errors, missed discrepancies included, come from the operators and normalization, which a better parser alone cannot fix. Every rejection comes with a trace of the units and evidence behind it, which suits examiner-in-the-loop review.

articles.titleCn: 从信用证要求到可执行规范：评估验证准确性和完整性
articles.abstractCn: 在信用证（LC）文件审核中，正确的最终决策并不表明所有要求都得到了审查。因此，我们逐项评估审查要求，并确保每项要求均可执行。语言模型将信用证中的提单（BL）和商业发票（IV）要求转化为原子条件和逻辑结构，确定性验证器检索命名证据并计算每个结果，以便每项检查都可以与黄金编码进行比较，并追溯到已记录的证据。由于信用证记录具有保密性，我们的本地9B解析器仅使用基于模板构建并由人工审核的公共文档值生成的合成对进行微调。在345个真实信用证案例中，最终决策的准确性证明具有误导性：一个恒定的PASS规则在什么也不审查的情况下具有最高的原始准确率。尽管在训练过程中从未见过真实记录，但微调后的解析器检测到其本体涵盖的93%的原子要求，并精确重建了86%的涵盖要求。它正确验证了82%的可评估要求，而使用工具的代理仅为54%，并且在满足要求和存在差异方面均领先于代理。它还比相同模型的少样本提示完全审查了1.8倍多的案例，而直接预测和使用代理均未完成。使用相同的验证器执行黄金编码表明，其中一些剩余错误，包括遗漏的差异，来自操作员和标准化，仅靠更好的解析器无法解决。每项拒绝都附带其背后单位和证据的追踪记录，这适用于人工审核员介入的审查。

articles.title: Isolating the Language Shell: A Content-Controlled Study of Multilingual Reasoning
articles.abstract: Multilingual reasoning distillation requires choosing the language in which teacher reasoning is presented, yet existing recipes often entangle linguistic form with differences in generation, translation, and filtering. We construct content-controlled supervision by rendering the same verified English trajectories into English, translated target-language, and language-mixed shells, and fine-tune two pretrained students in three target languages, evaluating them on multilingual mathematical reasoning at two difficulty levels. Even with the underlying reasoning content held fixed, we find that shell choice can change downstream accuracy, with effects varying across students, languages, and difficulty levels. Pre-training compatibility does not consistently track these outcomes, and even when our tests find no clear accuracy difference between shells, their output-language behavior can still differ substantially. These results suggest that the supervision shell is a distinct design choice in multilingual reasoning distillation.
articles.titleCn: 隔离语言外壳：一项内容控制的多语言推理研究
articles.abstractCn: 多语言推理蒸馏需要选择教师推理呈现的语言，但现有的方法往往将语言形式与生成、翻译和过滤的差异混淆在一起。我们通过将相同的经过验证的英文轨迹渲染为英文、目标语言翻译和语言混合外壳，构建了内容控制的监督机制，并在三个目标语言的两个难度级别的多语言数学推理上微调两个预训练的学生模型。即使推理内容保持不变，我们发现外壳选择可以改变下游准确率，且这种影响在不同学生、语言和难度级别上存在差异。预训练兼容性并不始终与这些结果保持一致，即使我们的测试发现外壳之间没有明显的准确率差异，它们的输出语言行为仍然可能存在显著不同。这些结果表明，监督外壳是多语言推理蒸馏中的一个独立设计选择。

articles.title: NightmareDiscourseBench: A Benchmark Dataset for Fictional Direct Discourse Identification Pipelines
articles.abstract: In this paper we introduce a new benchmark dataset, NightmareDiscourseBench, for testing NLP pipelines that identify forms of direct discourse in English-language fiction. We first review existing publicly available benchmarks (providing summary statistics and reviewing available metadata) for this task, identifying theoretical inconsistency and exclusive focus on speech as primary issues in this domain. We then overview our narrative theory-based framework for classifying and evaluating different forms of direct discourse, and finally describe NightmareDiscourseBench, a new benchmark test set of 12 text samples accompanied by metadata pertinent to the task of direct discourse identification.
articles.titleCn: 噩梦话语基准：用于虚构直接话语识别流程的基准数据集
articles.abstractCn: 在本文中，我们介绍了一个新的基准数据集——NightmareDiscourseBench，用于测试识别英语小说中直接话语形式的NLP流程。我们首先回顾了该任务现有的公开基准数据集（提供总结统计数据并审查可用元数据），指出了理论不一致性和该领域对言语的独家关注是主要问题。然后，我们概述了基于叙事理论的框架，用于分类和评估不同形式的直接话语，最后描述了NightmareDiscourseBench，这是一个包含12个文本样本及其与直接话语识别任务相关的元数据的新基准测试集。

articles.title: When Do LLM-Elicited Priors Help? A Controlled Audit of Language Models as Priors for Small-Sample Bayesian Regression
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly asked where to center the coefficients of a small-sample Bayesian regression, but the evidence is unclear: benchmarks are often built to match the prior and models may remember them. We audit this practice with one frontier and one flash-tier model, using hidden feature names, post-cutoff housing data and a pre-specified test that gives features the wrong descriptions. First, the models share their errors (correlation $0.92$--$0.99$ across draws, vendors and paraphrases): averaging $20$ draws is no more accurate than one, and treating draws as independent creates overconfidence. Much of this error comes from reporting each feature's effect alone, not with the others held fixed. Second, against the best classical prior, the LLM center helps clearly on one of four benchmarks (RMSE $-5.8\%$), marginally on two, and hurts mean RMSE on the fourth. Third, the LLM's stated uncertainty is unreliable; letting the data set the prior scale cuts the harm of a wrong center four-fold against a unit-variance prior. A pre-specified external test returned the verdict \textsc{partial}: on $18$ rule-selected problems the center helps on six and hurts on four, and a hard trust gate trusts a harmful prior while an evidence-weighted mixture is safer.
articles.titleCn: 当LLM引导的先验何时有帮助？对语言模型作为小样本贝叶斯回归先验的受控审计
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被要求确定小样本贝叶斯回归的系数中心位置，但证据尚不明确：基准测试通常是为了匹配先验分布，而模型可能会记住这些测试。我们使用一个前沿模型和一个闪速级模型，通过隐藏特征名称、截断后的住房数据以及一个预先指定的错误描述特征的测试，来审计这一做法。首先，模型共享它们的误差（在不同抽样、供应商和改述中的相关性为0.92至0.99）：平均20次抽样并不比单次抽样更准确，而将抽样视为独立会导致过度自信。大部分误差来自于单独报告每个特征的效应，而不是在固定其他特征的情况下报告。其次，相对于最佳经典先验分布，LLM的中心化在四个基准测试中的一个是明显有帮助的（RMSE降低了5.8%），在两个上有微小帮助，而在第四个上损害了平均RMSE。第三，LLM声称的不确定性是不可靠的；让数据集设定先验尺度相对于单位方差先验分布将错误中心的危害减少了四倍。预先指定的外部测试给出了部分通过的结论：在18个规则选择的问题中，中心化在六个问题上是有帮助的，在四个上是有害的，而一个硬信任门会信任有害的先验分布，而一个证据加权的混合模型则更安全。

articles.title: How Far Does Lossless Re-tokenization Move an RLVR Update?
articles.abstract: Language models assign different probabilities to token sequences that decode to the same string. In reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR), a trainer that re-encodes sampled text may train on a different token sequence with the same reward. We ask how far this moves a training update, and whether the movement has a consistent direction. From one checkpoint, we compare updates on the same rollouts, canonical and with selected tokens split into two pieces, against an update on a different batch. On Qwen2.5-0.5B with three-digit addition, splitting about one token in 25 moves the update 0.556 times as far as replacing the batch. The ratio rises with the fraction split in four models and depends on which tokens are split; within a checkpoint, the displacements share a direction across batches. In a tabular model with one table per tokenization and a single sampled string, we prove that whenever two strings below an unsampled prefix differ in probability, only the zero full-gradient step agrees across tokenizations, however it is weighted. In an audit that decodes and re-encodes resampled rollouts, re-encoding touches up to 5.2% of rollouts but at most 0.08% of tokens, far below the split fractions we test. Training on fixed rollouts, the canonical arm finishes ahead in 14 of 18 pre-registered pairs; the interval for the mean accuracy difference includes zero over all pairs and excludes it only under the registered exclusion rule, which favours the canonical arm.
articles.titleCn: 无损重标记如何推动RLVR更新？
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型会对解码为相同字符串的标记序列分配不同的概率。在可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）中，重新编码采样文本的训练者可能会在具有相同奖励的不同标记序列上进行训练。我们探究这种操作会使训练更新移动多远，以及这种移动是否具有一致的方向。从一个检查点开始，我们比较在同一序列上的更新（标准更新和选定的标记分成两段），与在不同批次上的更新。在Qwen2.5-0.5B进行三位数加法时，将大约25个标记中的一个分成两段，会使更新移动的距离仅为替换批次的0.556倍。该比例在四个模型中随分割比例的增加而上升，并且取决于分割的标记；在同一检查点内，不同批次上的位移方向一致。在一个每个标记化对应一个表格、且只有一个采样字符串的表格模型中，我们证明，在未采样的前缀下，当两个字符串的概率不同时，只有零全梯度步长在所有标记化中保持一致，无论其权重如何。在一个解码并重新编码重采样序列的审计中，重新编码最多影响5.2%的序列，但最多仅影响0.08%的标记，远低于我们测试的分割比例。在固定序列上进行训练时，标准分支在18个预先注册的对中赢了14个；平均准确率差异的区间在所有对中包含零，仅在注册排除规则下（该规则有利于标准分支）排除零。

articles.title: ORION: Exact Canonical-State Supervision for Systematic Generalization in Transformers
articles.abstract: Autoregressive Transformers generally fail on out-of-distribution reasoning due to two primary reasons: positional corruption over long sequences and structural state drift across deep execution steps. We introduce ORION, a framework that supervises exact canonical execution states via auxiliary heads to anchor latent trajectories to valid computational manifolds. Across Folding, GridShift, and CLRS-30, a pre-registered 2 x 2 factorial shows that RoPE and ORION address orthogonal axes. RoPE recovers length extrapolation (59.8%), while ORION recovers depth extrapolation (66.7%). Moreover, their combination complementarily achieves strict additive gain in joint length-depth extrapolation, while either method alone offers near satisfactory results. Negative controls confirm that the gain depends strictly on exact canonical alignment; hashed state statistics fail to constrain depth extrapolation.
articles.titleCn: ORION：针对Transformer的系统性泛化，实现精确规范状态监督
articles.abstractCn: 自回归Transformer通常在分布外推理方面表现不佳，这主要归因于两个原因：长序列中的位置信息损坏以及深层执行步骤中的结构状态漂移。我们引入了ORION框架，该框架通过辅助头监督精确的规范执行状态，将潜在轨迹锚定到有效的计算流形上。在Folding、GridShift和CLRS-30等任务上进行的预先注册的2x2析因实验表明，RoPE和ORION分别解决了正交的维度问题。RoPE恢复了长度外推（59.8%），而ORION恢复了深度外推（66.7%）。此外，它们的组合互补地实现了联合长度-深度外推的严格加性增益，而单独使用任一方法都能获得接近令人满意的结果。负向控制实验证实，这种增益严格依赖于精确的规范对齐；哈希状态统计无法约束深度外推。

articles.title: PLoQ: A Prompt-Specific Low-Rank Basis for 4-bit Quantization of LLM Activations
articles.abstract: Low-bit activation quantization of large language models remains challenging, as a small number of dominant directions dictate the quantization range. State-of-the-art methods isolate these directions in a high-precision subspace through transformations calibrated offline and folded into the weights, which fixes the subspace for all prompts, leaving each prompt's few unique directions unprotected, and rules it out wherever no weight can absorb the transformation. We present PLoQ, a prompt-adaptive low-rank decomposition that extracts the dominant activation components before quantization, quantizes them separately, and restores them within the layer's GEMM, without modifying the weights. The low-rank component's basis is estimated from each prompt during prefill and reused throughout decoding. At the same bit width as state-of-the-art mixed-precision quantization (4-bit weights, activations and K/V cache with an eighth of the channels at 8 bits, about 4.2 bits per activation on average), PLoQ outperforms it on all six Llama and Qwen models from 1B to 70B parameters, at up to 8k tokens (16k on two of them), recovering up to 46% of the perplexity that the state of the art still loses to 4-bit activations. On Llama-3.1-8B at 8k tokens it adds only 4% to prefill and 8% to decoding.
articles.titleCn: PLoQ：针对提示的LLM激活4位量化的特定低秩基
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型的低比特激活量化仍然具有挑战性，因为少数主导方向决定了量化范围。最先进的方法通过离线校准的变换在高精度子空间中隔离这些方向，并将变换折叠到权重中，这为所有提示固定了子空间，导致每个提示的少数独特方向无法得到保护，并在权重无法吸收变换的地方将其排除在外。我们提出了PLoQ，一种提示自适应的低秩分解方法，它在量化之前提取主导激活分量，单独进行量化，并在层的GEMM中恢复它们，而无需修改权重。低秩分量的基在prefill期间从每个提示中估计，并在解码过程中重复使用。与最先进的混合精度量化（4比特权重、激活和K/V缓存，其中八分之一的通道为8比特，平均每个激活约4.2比特）相同位宽下，PLoQ在从1B到70B参数的六个Llama和Qwen模型上均表现更优，最高可达8k个token（其中两个模型可达16k个token），恢复了最先进方法仍损失给4比特激活高达46%的困惑度。在Llama-3.1-8B模型上，当token数量为8k时，它仅在prefill阶段增加了4%，在解码阶段增加了8%。

articles.title: Separating Automation Gains from Agent Contributions in AI-Assisted Model Validation
articles.abstract: LLM agents are being proposed for bank model validation, yet evaluations that compare agent-assisted work with manual practice credit the agent with gains that come from digitized evidence and deterministic tests. We propose a staged architecture in which an LLM-free controlled workflow (P1) is both the fallback and the control arm for individually authorized agent tasks (P2), and an attribution protocol that credits an agent only for faults P1 does not already report. The protocol charges decoy false alarms, unnecessary actions and endorsed developer assertions, counts invalid outputs as misses, folds newly automatable findings back into P1 with discovery credit, and fixes safety bounds and a break-even cost gate in advance. On a synthetic credit-scorecard harness, five scripted reference policies show why this matters: naive case accuracy (4/6) and pooled detection (3/5) tie four flawed policies, whereas the protocol separates all five and credits only the reference policy with detection beyond P1. One fold-back round raises a P1-parroting policy's naive scores without any change to the policy. A regression matrix of sixteen mutants covers nine ways in which earlier versions of the evaluation passed misleadingly. No LLM agent has been evaluated yet; we specify a falsifiable pilot.
articles.comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Synthetic evaluation pack and reproducibility code included as ancillary material
articles.titleCn: 在AI辅助模型验证中区分自动化收益与代理贡献
articles.abstractCn: 针对银行模型验证，正提出使用大型语言模型代理，但现有评估将代理带来的收益归因于数字化证据和确定性测试。我们提出一种分阶段架构，其中无大型语言模型的受控工作流程（P1）既是备用方案，也是授权代理任务（P2）的对照方案，并设计一种归因协议，仅将代理的功劳归于P1未报告的错误。该协议将虚假警报、不必要操作和开发者断言计入成本，将无效输出视为遗漏，将新可自动化的发现重新纳入P1并给予发现奖励，并提前修正安全边界和盈亏平衡成本门槛。在一个合成信用评分卡测试平台上，五种脚本化参考策略展示了其重要性：朴素案例准确率（4/6）和池化检测（3/5）使四种有缺陷的策略并列，而协议将所有五种策略区分开来，仅将超出P1的检测功劳归于参考策略。一次回折操作使模仿P1的策略的朴素评分提升，而策略本身未作任何修改。一个包含十六个变体的回归矩阵涵盖了早期评估版本通过误导性方式通过测试的九种方式。目前尚未评估任何大型语言模型代理；我们指定了一个可证伪的试点方案。

articles.title: Reasoning in Two Dimensions: Quantifying Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness and Efficiency
articles.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning exposes intermediate steps, but a correct answer does not establish that an LLM relies on the dependence expressed by those steps or reasons efficiently. We operationalize CoT faithfulness and efficiency within a common framework. Specifically, we represent a CoT as a semantic reasoning graph and decompose the model's predictive dependence along two complementary axes: dependence explained by semantic support versus additional reasoning history, and dependence allocated to answer-reaching versus off-path reasoning. This decomposition yields global and step-level measures of unfaithfulness and inefficiency. Controlled interventions show that the proposed metrics respond to hidden dependence and induced off-path reasoning as intended. Across mathematical and multi-hop reasoning tasks, answer-level unfaithfulness is consistently associated with greater predictive uncertainty, whereas both unfaithfulness and inefficiency exhibit weak or inconsistent associations with answer correctness. We further derive theoretically grounded, graph-aware fine-tuning objectives that improve the targeted reasoning properties without directly optimizing the computationally expensive metrics or compromising answer accuracy. Results indicate that accuracy and brevity provide incomplete assessments of reasoning quality: reliable CoT evaluation should also consider whether the LLM's predictive dependence is faithfully represented and efficiently allocated.
articles.titleCn: 二维推理：量化思维链的可靠性与效率
articles.abstractCn: 思维链（CoT）推理会暴露中间步骤，但正确答案并不能证明大型语言模型（LLM）依赖这些步骤所表达的依赖关系或高效地推理。我们在一个通用框架内对CoT的忠实性和效率进行操作化。具体而言，我们将CoT表示为一个语义推理图，并沿两个互补的轴分解模型的预测依赖关系：由语义支持解释的依赖关系与额外的推理历史，以及分配给答案达成与偏离路径推理的依赖关系。这种分解产生了不忠实性和低效率的全局和步骤级度量。受控干预表明，所提出的指标如预期般响应了隐藏的依赖关系和诱导的偏离路径推理。在数学和多跳推理任务中，答案级不忠实性与更高的预测不确定性始终相关，而不忠实性和低效率则与答案正确性表现出弱关联或不一致关联。我们进一步推导出基于理论、考虑图结构的微调目标，这些目标在不直接优化计算成本高的指标或牺牲答案准确性的情况下，提升了目标推理特性。结果表明，准确性和简洁性对推理质量的评估是不完整的：可靠的CoT评估还应考虑LLM的预测依赖关系是否被忠实地表示和高效地分配。

articles.title: Cross-Platform Production Signatures of State-Linked Information Operations
articles.abstract: An information operation active on several platforms presents different names, personas, and topics on each. Its working routine is harder to change. We call this routine the operation's production signature: the regularities in when and how its accounts post, reply, and repost. We measure it from timestamps and coarse action types only, using no content, profile metadata, or network ties, as timing and action profiles for accounts and learned action-gap policies for populations. We then ask which parts of a signature carry over to another platform and which belong to a single operation. We train models on Twitter archives of four state-linked operations and apply them to Internet Research Agency (IRA) accounts on Reddit, with no Reddit training labels. They rank the IRA accounts at AUC 0.90-0.94. Content detectors on the same route fall from 0.98 within a platform to 0.81. Daily phase accounts for most of the transfer. Posting volume reverses direction between platforms, and action mix follows the role accounts hold on each platform. What transfers is not unique to the IRA: a second operation shares the same working-hours window, and action-gap policies separate every operation from organic accounts (AUC 0.96-1.0) without consistently ranking their own operation first. On 938 Telegram channels, groups that forward the same sources keep ordinary hours and pace but publish original posts in the same ten-minute windows more often than chance. This pattern is invisible when accounts are examined one at a time. Our results suggest that timing and action traces learned on one platform can help flag likely operations on another.
articles.titleCn: 与国家相关信息行动的跨平台生产特征
articles.abstractCn: 一个在多个平台上活跃的信息行动，在不同的平台上呈现出不同的名称、身份和主题。其工作流程更难改变。我们称这种流程为行动的生产签名：其账号发布、回复和转发的时间和方式的规律性。我们仅根据时间戳和粗略的行动类型进行衡量，不使用内容、个人资料元数据或网络关系，而是使用账号的时间和行动特征以及针对人群学习到的行动差距策略。然后我们询问哪些签名部分会转移到另一个平台，哪些属于单一行动。我们在四个与国家相关的行动的推特存档上训练模型，并将它们应用于Reddit上的互联网研究局（IRA）账号，没有使用Reddit的训练标签。它们对IRA账号的排名准确率达到了0.90-0.94。同一路线上的内容检测器在同一平台内准确率从0.98下降到0.81。大多数转移发生在每日阶段账号。发布量在平台之间逆转方向，行动组合则遵循账号在每个平台上的角色。转移的并非IRA独有：第二个行动共享相同的工作时间窗口，行动差距策略将每个行动与有机账号区分开来（准确率0.96-1.0），但并不始终将自身行动排在首位。在938个Telegram频道中，转发相同来源的群组保持常规时间和节奏，但在同一十分钟的窗口内发布原创帖子比偶然更频繁。当单独检查账号时，这种模式是不可见的。我们的结果表明，在一个平台上学习到的时间和行动轨迹可以帮助在另一个平台上识别可能的行动。

articles.title: Double counting in LLM evidence fusion: exact posteriors separate rule compliance from posterior gain
articles.abstract: Language models fuse reports in retrieval, multi-agent consensus and agent memory, where treating shared-source reports as independent can double count evidence. A common remedy is an instruction to count each source once. Its value depends on the receiver's raw baseline. Pricing it needs an exact reference. We build the graded-dependence exact reference: binary worlds with single-report reliability 0.65 and four dependence levels, whose disclosed parameters give every world an exact posterior and every rule a target risk. The paired gain protocol scores raw and instructed answers of four configurations on 2,976 worlds. Agreement and gain separate in both directions. At $δ$ = 0, claude-opus-5-5 and gpt-6.1-sol agreed with the rule within 0.001 in 744 of 744, and the instruction raised their posterior mismatch by 0.044; gpt-6-luna agreed in 165 of 744 and gained 0.0140 (95% interval 0.0064 to 0.0219); claude-haiku-5-5's gain moved from -0.0295 ($δ$ = 0) to +0.0302 ($δ$ = 1) (descriptive). The prespecified first-child endpoint contrast, gain at $δ$ = 1 minus $δ$ = 0, was 0.0342 (0.0303 to 0.0382). In the preregistered tests, the raw source-weight contrast was positive (0.259, 95% interval 0.182 to 0.337; Holm rejected zero) and the grouping endpoint difference was not detected (0.0004, -0.0023 to 0.0031). This interval excludes differences larger than 0.0031 in magnitude and lies within the registered precision bound of $\pm$0.0046. The reference prices the rule before any model call. The paired gain, estimable as a Brier difference on labelled deployment items, decides adoption per receiver and prompt condition.
