articles.titleCn: 在LLM证据融合中的重复计算：精确后验概率将规则合规性与后验增益区分开来
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型在检索、多智能体共识和智能体记忆中融合报告，若将共享来源的报告视为独立则会导致证据重复计算。一种常见的解决方法是要求每个来源只计数一次。其价值取决于接收者的原始基线。对其定价需要一个精确参考。我们构建了分级依赖精确参考：包含单一报告可靠性为0.65的二进制世界和四个依赖级别，其公开参数为每个世界提供精确后验概率，为每条规则设定目标风险。配对增益协议在2976个世界中对四种配置的原始和指令回答进行评分。一致性和增益在两个方向上分离。在$δ$ = 0时，claude-opus-5-5和gpt-6.1-sol在744个中的744个世界内与规则的一致性在0.001以内，且指令使它们的后验概率不匹配增加了0.044；gpt-6-luna在165个中的744个世界内达成一致，并获得了0.0140（95%区间0.0064至0.0219）；claude-haiku-5-5的增益从-0.0295（$δ$ = 0）变为+0.0302（$δ$ = 1）（描述性）。预设的第一子节点终点对比，$δ$ = 1时的增益减去$δ$ = 0时的增益，为0.0342（0.0303至0.0382）。在预先注册的测试中，原始来源权重对比为正值（0.259，95%区间0.182至0.337；Holm拒绝零假设）且分组终点差异未检测到（0.0004，-0.0023至0.0031）。该区间排除了幅度大于0.0031的差异，且位于注册的精度界限±0.0046内。该参考在模型调用前对规则进行定价。配对增益，可视为在标记部署项上的Brier差异进行估计，决定每个接收者和提示条件下的采纳。

articles.title: Do Senior Agents Do Their Job? Measuring Role Integrity in How LLM Agents Use Subordinate Material
articles.abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems increasingly divide long tasks among subagents whose reports a senior agent turns into the final answer. Such a division of labor pays off only if each agent, and above all the senior agent, carries out the duties of its role. Current evaluations, however, mostly score the final answer, and a fluent, well-cited answer cannot show whether the senior agent weighed its subagents' reports or merely aggregated them. To assess whether a senior agent meets its assigned responsibilities, we define role integrity as the preservation of an agent's functional responsibilities when it acts on its subordinates' material. To measure it, we introduce RI-Bench, a behavioral benchmark grounded in the structures and public records of three institutional hierarchies: peer review, appellate adjudication, and parliamentary inquiry. We choose these hierarchies because their rules explicitly assign the senior role a duty toward subordinate material, and together they cover three basic duties: to weigh, to verify, and to relay. Rather than scoring output correctness, we measure how senior agents' outputs respond to controlled changes in subordinate material, using rule-based checks and a rubric-guided LLM judge calibrated against human annotation. Across eight LLMs and over 12,000 agentic episodes, senior agents rarely adopt a planted procedural error (2.9% of rulings) but often follow a majority of generic reviews (up to 71% of decisions) or drop witnesses' stated limitations (up to 65% of cited claims). Obligation prompts reduce these failures without removing them, and they also shift behavior in the control conditions. These findings motivate direct, obligation-specific evaluation of role integrity rather than inferring it from general capability or explicit role instructions. Code and data are available at https://github.com/jxtse/ri-bench.
articles.titleCn: 高级代理是否尽职尽责？衡量大型语言模型代理使用从属材料中的角色完整性
articles.abstractCn: 多智能体大语言模型系统越来越多地将长任务分配给子智能体，而高级智能体则将子智能体的报告转化为最终答案。这种分工只有在每个智能体，尤其是高级智能体，履行其职责时才能取得成效。然而，目前的评估主要针对最终答案进行评分，而流畅且引用充分的答案并不能表明高级智能体是否权衡了子智能体的报告，还是仅仅进行了汇总。为了评估高级智能体是否履行了其分配的职责，我们将角色完整性定义为智能体在处理下属材料时保持其功能职责的完整性。为了衡量这一点，我们引入了RI-Bench，这是一个基于三个机构层级结构（同行评审、上诉裁决和议会调查）的行为基准：这些层级的规则明确规定了高级角色对下属材料的责任，并且它们共同涵盖了三项基本职责：权衡、核实和转达。我们选择这些层级，是因为它们的规则明确规定了高级角色对下属材料的责任，并且它们共同涵盖了三项基本职责：权衡、核实和转达。我们不是通过评分输出的正确性，而是通过规则检查和由人类标注校准的评分指南LLM法官，来衡量高级智能体的输出如何响应下属材料中受控的变化。在八个LLM和超过12,000个智能体场景中，高级智能体很少采用预设的程序错误（裁决中有2.9%），但经常遵循多数通用评审（决策中有高达71%），或者忽略证人提出的限制（引用声明中有高达65%）。义务提示减少了这些错误，但没有完全消除它们，并且它们也改变了控制条件下的行为。这些发现表明，应该直接对角色完整性进行义务特定的评估，而不是从一般能力或明确的角色指令中推断。代码和数据可在https://github.com/jxtse/ri-bench获取。

articles.title: The Vulnerability Window: Decision Instability in Quantized Reward Models
articles.abstract: Reward models and LLM judges are routinely quantized to 4 bits so that scoring many candidates stays affordable, and the usual check is that benchmark accuracy barely moves. That check is close to blind. Across eight reward models from two families (0.6B-8B), three generative judges and four 4-bit quantizers, quantization rewrites 1.1-12.3% of pairwise preference decisions on RewardBench while aggregate accuracy moves by as little as 0.03 points (p = 1.00), because the errors it fixes and introduces cancel. Flips concentrate where the full-precision margin is small relative to the quantization noise scale sigma: a Gaussian approximation Phi(-|m|/sigma) describes the aggregate rate, over-predicting it in all 30 scalar settings and failing for generative judges, and occupancy of the resulting vulnerability window falls from 25% to 7% with model size, which is what makes small judges fragile. The churn stays within noise under benign best-of-16 and becomes clear under adversarial pressure for some quantizers (146:54 harmful:helpful flips on one family, reversing sign on another). Downstream it changes what ships: across six (model, quantizer) pairs from two families, 14.6-65.7% of problems get a different best-of-64 selection while only 2.6-9.6% get a different final answer, with selections changing 5-8x more often than answers in every pair, and the pair the benchmark calls identical (0.03 points, p = 1.00) still changes 34.5% of them. Benchmark churn ranks that downstream change (rho = 0.89); benchmark accuracy does not order it reliably. Held-out audits then locate the useful diagnostic in the margin rather than the Gaussian: every margin-based predictor orders flips identically (AUC 0.927), and on the level a directly measured churn rate wins in-distribution. As a routing signal it is matched by plain top-k. The contribution is the characterization, not the model.
articles.titleCn: 脆弱窗口：量化奖励模型中的决策不稳定性
articles.abstractCn: 奖励模型和大型语言模型（LLM）裁判通常量化为4位，以便在评估多个候选时保持成本可控，而常规检查是基准精度几乎未发生变化。这种检查近乎盲目。在两个家族（0.6B-8B）的八个奖励模型、三个生成式裁判和四个4位量化器中，量化在RewardBench上改写了1.1-12.3%的成对偏好决策，而总精度变化仅为0.03分（p = 1.00），因为其修正和引入的错误相互抵消。翻转集中在全精度裕度相对于量化噪声尺度sigma较小的地方：一个高斯近似Phi(-|m|/sigma)描述了总速率，在所有30个标量设置中均高估了它，并且对于生成式裁判无效，结果漏洞窗口的占用率随着模型规模从25%降至7%，这就是小型裁判脆弱的原因。在良性最佳16轮（best-of-16）下，更替保持在噪声范围内，但在对抗压力下对某些量化器变得明显（在一个家族中146:54的有害:有益翻转，在另一个家族中符号反转）。下游它改变了哪些被选中：在两个家族的六个（模型、量化器）对中，14.6-65.7%的问题获得了不同的最佳64轮选择，而只有2.6-9.6%的问题获得了不同的最终答案，选择的变化频率是答案的5-8倍，基准称为相同的对（0.03分，p = 1.00）仍然有34.5%的变化。基准更替对下游变化进行排序（rho = 0.89）；基准精度无法可靠地排序它。保留的审计然后在裕度而非高斯中定位有用的诊断：基于裕度的每个预测器都以相同的方式排序翻转（AUC 0.927），并且在直接测量的更替率在分布内获胜。作为路由信号，它被简单的top-k匹配。贡献在于特征描述，而非模型。

articles.title: Co-Evolving Behavioral Agents and Detectors for Adaptive Information Operations
articles.abstract: Detectors of state-sponsored information operations (IOs) are trained on campaigns that platforms have already taken down. They lose much of their accuracy on an actor they have not seen, even though no operator in the archived data is trying to avoid them. A real operator wants two things, to reach an audience and to avoid being caught. We present IO-AI, a framework that gives simulated agents these two capabilities, engagement and evasion, and tests what each one does to detection. The agents are built from the posting behavior of real campaigns and choose the emotion, type, and timing of each post. An agent and a detector then train against each other in turn. We rank the trained agents by how hard they are to detect and train one detector on them from easiest to hardest. On 20 Twitter IO campaigns, this detector reduces missed detections of adaptive agents by 65% relative to a detector trained only on the archived campaigns, at a similar false-alarm rate. On actors it has never seen it reaches an F1 of 0.81, against 0.62. We find that an agent trained to seek engagement becomes easier to catch, because it learns the fast, emotional retweeting that archived campaigns were caught producing. An agent that was trained for engagement before the game keeps its engagement lead after it learns to evade. We also introduce a behavioral distance metric that compares two groups of accounts using only their unlabeled posting histories. The larger the distance between two groups, the worse a detector trained on one does on the other (Spearman rho = -0.58), so the metric can be used to choose which new groups to test first.
articles.titleCn: 协同进化行为代理与检测器以实现自适应信息作战
articles.abstractCn: 针对国家支持的信息行动（IO）的检测器是在平台已下架的行动中训练的。它们在遇到未见过行为者时，即使归档数据中的操作员没有试图规避，准确率也会大幅下降。真实操作员希望达到两个目标：触达受众并避免被捕获。我们提出了IO-AI框架，该框架赋予模拟代理这两种能力——参与和规避，并测试了每种能力对检测的影响。代理基于真实行动的发布行为构建，选择每条帖子的情绪、类型和时间。然后代理与检测器交替进行训练。我们根据检测难度对训练后的代理进行排序，并从易到难依次训练检测器。在20个Twitter信息行动中，该检测器相较于仅在归档行动上训练的检测器，将自适应代理的漏检率降低了65%，且误报率相似。在从未见过行为者的情况下，该检测器达到了0.81的F1分数，而归档行动训练的检测器仅为0.62。我们发现，训练为寻求参与的代理更容易被捕获，因为它学会了归档行动被捕获的快速情绪性转发。在游戏开始前接受参与训练的代理，在学会规避后仍能保持参与优势。我们还引入了一种行为距离度量指标，仅使用未标记的发布历史来比较两组账号。两组之间的距离越大，基于其中一组训练的检测器在另一组上的表现就越差（Spearman rho = -0.58），因此该指标可用于选择最先测试的新组别。

articles.title: What Does Matching a Human Intervention Effect Establish? Benchmark Checks for LLM Simulations
articles.abstract: LLM simulations are validated by equivalence with human effects, yet a zero reference passes whenever the human 90 percent interval lies inside the margin, as the human benchmark shows before simulation. When the zero reference fails, planned precision gives independent simulations the margin up to which passing is a 5 percent test of response. In an exploratory 70-experiment reanalysis, 72 percent of GPT-4's $\pm$0.20 SD passes were zero-reference passes; GPT-4 passed 16 contrasts the zero reference failed (1.58 expected without response). In a preregistered audit, Claude Sonnet 5.5 passed three intention targets, all zero-reference passes, and the registered belief-gradient control; norm beliefs changed 0.065 SD against humans' 0.351 (zero-reference check added after unblinding; norm beliefs emphasized after inspection). Registered tests detected no overestimation; average-effect intervals excluded overestimation above 0.08 SD. A group audit's precision floor is 1.33 facts against a 2.9-fact effect. Report the zero-reference threshold beside every equivalence decision.
articles.titleCn: 匹配人类干预效果建立什么？针对LLM模拟的基准检查
articles.abstractCn: LLM模拟通过与人效的等价性进行验证，但零参考通过的条件是当人类90%置信区间落在误差范围内，因为人类基准在模拟前就已显示。当零参考失效时，计划精度为独立模拟提供了通过测试的误差范围，通过率作为5%的响应测试。在一项包含70次实验的探索性再分析中，72%的GPT-4的±0.20标准差通过率是零参考通过；GPT-4通过了16个零参考未通过的对比（预期通过率为1.58个响应）。在一项预先注册的审计中，Claude Sonnet 5.5通过了三个意图目标，均为零参考通过，并通过了注册的信念梯度控制；规范信念的变化为0.065标准差，而人类为0.351（零参考检查在去盲后添加；规范信念在检查后强调）。注册测试未检测到高估；平均效应区间排除了超过0.08标准差的高估。一组审计的精度下限为1.33个事实，而效应为2.9个事实。在每次等价性决策旁边报告零参考阈值。

articles.title: How Much of a Calculation-Error Rate Is Not Arithmetic: Auditing the FinReason Cup 2026 Task 3 Metric with a Deterministic Rule System
articles.abstract: Task 3 of the FinReason Cup 2026 scores a system on two values per case, the one an XBRL filing reports and the one its own calculation relationships imply, and labels each failure as structural, extraction or calculation. This report shows that the calculation-error rate so defined does not count arithmetic failures, and bounds how far it is from one using the published board alone. One of the three rules behind the benchmark, DQC_US_0015, has an answer that is the negation of the reported value (in all 110 published practice cases, against 1 of 120 and 6 of 102 for the other two), so a calculation label on such a case records a wrong fact or a wrong route, not a wrong sum. Subtracting the available structural and extraction labels from each entry's error count on that rule gives a floor: the bound is positive for 22 of the 23 ranked entries, and at the top it is sharpest, with at least 11 of 12 and 12 of 13 calculation errors of the two joint-first entries falling on cases where no arithmetic remained. The calculation-error rate of the best systems on this task is almost entirely not arithmetic. The vehicle for that result is an entry that reconstructs the three data-quality rules the benchmark is drawn from, DQC_US_0015, DQC_US_0117 and DQC_US_0126, as a deterministic system with no learned parameters, no training step and no external service, running all 680 cases in 1.4 seconds. It scores 96.62% under the offline judge on development and 95.29% on the published test set, and its residual error concentrates in cases where a concept carries several equally flagged facts and the question names no dimensional member. Reading those error classes against the per-rule accuracies is what exposed the metric, which is why both are reported here.
articles.comment: 7 pages, 3 tables. FinReason Cup 2026 (IEEE Big Data 2026) Task 3 Working Notes
articles.titleCn: 计算误差率中有多少不是算术误差：使用确定性规则系统审计FinReason Cup 2026任务3指标
articles.abstractCn: FinReason Cup 2026 的任务3对每个案例在两个值上评分，一个是XBRL报告值，另一个是其计算关系所暗示的值，并将每个失败标记为结构性、提取性或计算性。本报告表明，如此定义的计算错误率不包括算术错误，并界定了其与仅使用发布版数据相比的差距。基准背后的三条规则之一DQC_US_0015的答案与报告值相反（在所有110个已发布的实践案例中，与其他两条规则相比，分别有1个和6个案例出现这种情况），因此在该规则上的计算标签记录的是错误事实或错误路径，而非错误总和。从该规则下每个案例的错误计数中减去可用的结构性和提取性标签，可得出一个下限：该界限对23个排名案例中的22个为正值，在顶端最为尖锐，两个并列第一的案例中至少有11个和12个计算错误出现在没有算术运算的案例中。该任务上最佳系统的计算错误率几乎完全不是算术错误。实现这一结果的是一项重建了基准所依据的三条数据质量规则DQC_US_0015、DQC_US_0117和DQC_US_0126的案例，作为一个无学习参数、无训练步骤、无外部服务的确定性系统，在1.4秒内运行了全部680个案例。它在离线判别器上的开发集得分率为96.62%，在已发布测试集上的得分为95.29%，其残差错误集中在概念包含多个同等标记的事实且问题未命名维度成员的案例中。正是通过将这些错误类别与每条规则的准确率进行对比，才揭示了该指标，这也是为什么两者都在此报告。

articles.title: Explicit Style Extraction for Personalized Long-Form Text Generation
articles.abstract: Personalized long-form generation asks a language model to write new text the way a specific user would. The standard recipe, retrieval-augmented generation, places a few of the user's past texts in the prompt but leaves the model to decide what to take from them. We introduce StylePrism, a taxonomy of 28 stylistic aspects in seven categories, and SP-Refine, an inference-time method that makes style extraction an explicit step: the model first fills StylePrism with the user's patterns, quoted evidence, and habits to avoid, then drafts from the user's samples and revises the draft twice against this profile, guided by its own style scores. On the three long-form tasks of LongLaMP with three LLMs, SP-Refine outperforms LongLaMP's retrieval-augmented baseline in 25 of 27 ROUGE and METEOR comparisons, by 10.2% on average and by up to 35.8%. Annotating users' own texts with the extracted profiles shows that StylePrism captures concrete, checkable habits, from the order of rhetorical moves to a reviewer's sign-off. Ablations show that the profile helps as revision guidance, not as a replacement for the samples: writing from the profile alone is worse in all 27 comparisons, while a single implicit-inference call is a cheaper alternative that comes close. Oracle variants that let the reviser see the reference, together with reference-free controls, show that larger refinement gains require information unavailable at inference time.
articles.titleCn: 个性化长文本生成中的显式风格提取
articles.abstractCn: 个性化长文本生成要求语言模型以特定用户的方式撰写新文本。标准方法——检索增强生成，将用户的部分历史文本置于提示中，但由模型自行决定从中提取内容。我们引入了StylePrism，一个包含七个类别中28个风格方面的分类体系，以及SP-Refine，一种在推理时将风格提取作为显式步骤的方法：模型首先用用户的模式、引用证据和需避免的习惯填充StylePrism，然后从用户样本中起草，并依据该档案进行两次修订，由模型自身的风格评分进行指导。在LongLaMP的三个长文本任务上，使用三个大型语言模型进行测试，SP-Refine在27次ROUGE和METEOR比较中的25次优于LongLaMP的检索增强基线，平均提升10.2%，最高提升达35.8%。标注用户文本提取的档案显示，StylePrism捕捉了具体可验证的习惯，从修辞步骤的顺序到审稿人的最终确认。消融实验表明，档案作为修订指导而非样本替代，单独依据档案写作在所有27次比较中表现更差，而单次隐式推理调用则是一种更经济且接近的替代方案。允许修订者查看参考的Oracle变体，连同无参考控制组，表明更大的修订增益需要推理时不可用的信息。
